cues.text: Akihiko leads you into his room in the dorm. Training equipment stands among the furniture.
You sit down, and Akihiko stays standing across from you.
Akihiko turns away, walks across the room and starts searching.
You get up and walk over to the medal from his parents' parcel, set out in the room.
You take the medal and put it on Akihiko. He looks down at it in surprise.
